Kernel, Contract, Distribution und Werkzeuge, sofern sie kein kanonisches R4X-, R4D-, R4P- oder R4L-Modulprojekt besitzen.

entries.name: RECOVERY
entries.notes: Kanonische Recovery-Anwendung im gemeinsamen Recovery-Monorepo; Tastaturmenue und Consolehost ohne Desktop, eigener gepinnter SDK-/Contract-Build und 39 getrennt erfasste importierte Runtime-Module. Installation, SYSTEM-Ersatz mit erhaltenen Datenpartitionen und Bootmenues, GitHub-/ZIP-Quellen, CURRENT/PREVIOUS-Selbstupdate mit Bootbestaetigung und Kernel-/Runtime-Paarbindung. Recovery/Kernel 0.1.58 mit RECOVERY.R4X 0.1.21 akzeptiert die bisherigen kanonischen Release-Menues sowie die exakte Software-Grafik-Erweiterung aus R4OS 0.79.X. Vor dem SYSTEM-Update auf 0.79.8 zuerst Recovery aktualisieren und neu starten. Das Paket verlangt 2048 MB OS-nutzbaren RAM; jeder Auftrag reserviert seinen weiteren Arbeitsbedarf vor Zielschreibzugriffen. Selbstupdate aus der echten 0.1.57-Runtime und produktiver Ergebnisstart mit 3072 MB SMP4 geprueft; SYSTEM-Update auf 0.79.8 und Ergebnisstart mit 8192 MB SMP4 geprueft. Aktuelle Releases, Hashes und Abnahmegrenzen stehen in Docs/Deployment/Recovery.txt.

entries.name: R4BASIC
entries.notes: SUBSYSTEM_ID=r4os.basic; GUEST_FORMAT=basic.qbasic-source; module 1.2.35 and final contract 2.10.2. One parser-binder-emitter and a mandatory all-green catalog gate cover seven Part-1 fundamentals, all 193 Part-2 statements/functions, three metacommands and 43 Appendix-B errors. The permanent general positive/negative/runtime corpus and checksum-bound unchanged GORILLA full-round/reset/close acceptance cover source graphs, numerics, strings, declarations, procedures, files, R4OS platform semantics, all logical SCREEN modes, graphics, audio and events. The productive guest baseline additionally requires real intro PCM and a successful idle Close after the documented AUDSVC/HDA drain; 50-ms Open/Write/Volume and separate 500-ms Close bounds cover the verified four-CPU service latency, while degradation reports per-operation counters. Newly consumed sequence-tagged console input publishes its echo in the same guest slice and restarts the 33-ms cadence; non-input deferred frames retain their own guest wake deadline. Physical key transitions remain deliberately outside BASIC semantics. An exact private 1-MiB 20-bit machine provides guest pointers, bounded x86, ports, virtual interrupts and private foreign symbols; bounded COM/IOCTL and printer spools never expose host hardware. Retains one-outstanding-request bounded storage, event-driven waits, 262144-operation/8-ms slices, generation-safe shared Indexed8 presentation with bounded copy fallback and full instance isolation. 0.78.6 rebuild includes shared SDK silence pacing and stream retention across temporary producer gaps; five focused existing audio/wait cases pass.

entries.name: R4GB
entries.notes: SUBSYSTEM_ID=r4os.gb; GUEST_FORMAT=gameboy.dmg-cartridge; module 0.10.12. Original userland DMG implementation with explicit CPU revision profiles and no proprietary boot ROM. Complete owned-ROM validation, full-ROM SHA-256 identity, bounded 64-KiB bus and ROM-only/MBC1/MBC1M/MBC2/MBC3/MBC30/MBC5/MMM01/digital-HuC1 models provide the cartridge foundation; hardware-bound mapper and accessory families are rejected precisely. Battery cartridges persist exact raw SRAM and versioned checksummed MBC3 RTC state below C:\R4OS\SUBSYSTEMS\r4os.gb\SAVE using the compiled-in shared SDK persistence helper: one generation-bound writer lease and an asynchronous serial snapshot worker with coalescing, same-directory atomic replacement, bounded retries for transient stream not-found/I/O faults across stage and private transaction-lease Begin/Write/Finish, ownership-aware Abort/Release retries, checked normal transaction release, bounded replay of retained stages after interrupted or lost-acknowledgement writes, exact-size and RTC-content validation before replay, last-good backup preservation until the canonical target is independently resolvable and validated, and mandatory drain-on-close; partial or malformed stages and orphaned backups fail closed, the former pre-release APPDATA path is never probed at runtime, and the one affected laptop installation was restored byte-identically before activation; non-battery cartridges never persist. The source migration retains R4GB's cartridge and 80-byte RTC policy and introduces neither an R4L nor a platform ABI. The complete SM83 core covers all 244 legal base and 256 CB paths through explicit read/write/idle M-cycles. One bounded 4.194304-MHz Machine clock owns DIV/TIMA reload behavior, IF/IE priority and dispatch retargeting, HALT/STOP wake, 160-byte OAM DMA with restart and DMG source decoding, the active-low P1 keyboard matrix, deterministic SB/SC transfer without link transport and the MBC3 RTC across CPU halt/stop. The dot-clocked DMG-C PPU models LCD modes, STAT/LY quirks, VRAM/OAM blocking and corruption, FIFO background/window timing, ten-sprite selection and DMG priorities, publishing complete changed 160x144 Indexed8 frames once through the shared-raster path of subsystem_host with bounded copy fallback. The four-channel DMG APU implements NR52/DIV sequencing, pulse sweep/envelopes including the hardware-defined disabled zero-pace state, wave RAM, noise LFSR, NR50/NR51 mixing and high-pass-filtered deterministic 48-kHz stereo S16LE through subsystem_runtime and App-Audio/AUDSVC; backend failure degrades only audio. The productive R4SUBSYS1 GUI host gives every launch a private Machine, one 32768-T-cycle-bounded slice per host cycle, generation-safe native video, ordered physical input, explicit pause/resume/reset/mute actions, App-Audio transport, concrete in-window failures and one idempotent teardown for runtime, window, save worker, ROM and machine resources. Installed MODULES.JSON metadata and ID-only ASSOC entries drive .gb/.gbc Explorer and Open With launches. Generated original cartridges prove two simultaneous 60-second instances on one- and four-vCPU QEMU, timed focus and lifecycle input, video, lossless App-Audio/APU accounting, asynchronous SRAM/RTC persistence, retained-stage replay, partial-stage rejection, separate close and visible CGB-only rejection without using commercial ROMs. A machine-readable qualification matrix records licenses, revisions, hashes, protocols, timeouts, targets and ten justified non-DMG/peripheral exclusions for six open source families. All 500000 pinned SM83 vectors, 28 production-machine mapper ROMs, 34 clock/I/O Mooneye ROMs, 32 PPU Mooneye ROMs, three DMG SameSuite ROMs, 25 pixel-exact Acid2/Mealybug images, all three RTC3Test groups and the Mealybug MBC3-RTC ROM pass: 15 suites, 852 files and 500129 result records. A deterministic original E2E fixture and CPU/PPU/APU maturity harness prove host-speed-independent final state, while independent one- and four-vCPU 60-second QEMU WAV captures verify continuous real audio across lifecycle reset. 0.78.6 skips both persistence clocks for non-battery slices while retaining time and backend polls for active saves; the common audio runtime paces silence and keeps streams across transient producer gaps. 0.78.13: one immutable source ROM borrowed by cartridge/reset; cached header/digest and transactional allocation failure.

entries.name: R4SNES
entries.notes: SUBSYSTEM_ID=r4os.snes; GUEST_FORMAT=snes.cartridge; Original public Zig userland SNES subsystem with immutable LoROM/HiROM/ExLoROM/ExHiROM parsing, normalized SHA-256 identity, private WRAM/SRAM and a timed 24-bit bus. Executable cartridge owners cover OBC-1, S-RTC, S-DD1, SPC7110/Epson RTC, Super FX GSU-1/GSU-2, SA-1, CX4, NEC DSP-1/1A/1B/2/3/4, ST010/ST011 and ST018. ST018 uses an original ARMv3/ARM60 core with seven modes and banked state, pipeline, all conditions, ALU/barrel shifts, short/long multiply, single/block transfers, swap, branch/link, PSR operations and exceptions; exact 128-KiB program ROM, 32-KiB data ROM, 16-KiB work RAM, host bridge, timer and 65536-cycle ready delay are isolated per instance. Product ST018 execution requires exact digest-bound 163840-byte ST018.ROM at C:\R4OS\SUBSYSTEMS\r4os.snes\FIRMWARE and never downloads, embeds or HLEs it. A generated open fixture binds productive bus/RAM state to DE7069060A5E262D and pinned Ares/Mesen2 sources; an optional private gate validates and boots the known image in place without emitting bytes. ST018 work RAM is an exact battery-backed normalized-ROM HASH.SAV under C:\R4OS\SUBSYSTEMS\r4os.snes\SAVE, survives reset and restores before ARM execution. The same canonical save subtree and shared lease/serial snapshot worker also own ordinary SRAM, GSU RAM, SA-1 BW-RAM, ST010 RAM and checksummed RTC records. CPU, integer NTSC/PAL timing, DMA/HDMA, complete S-PPU, SPC700/S-SMP and S-DSP are qualified by 147 public ROMs, 256000 SPC700 state/bus vectors and focused exact-digest owner gates. Semantic IPL handling accepts collision-free non-sequential commands and evaluates port 0 only after the complete S-CPU/DMA operation so both halves of a 16-bit STA $2140 use the new payload. No commercial ROM or proprietary firmware is distributed. Port 1 uses arrows, Enter, right Control and keypad 2/4/6/7/8/9; port 2 is disconnected. The productive R4SUBSYS1 GUI host gives every launch a private cartridge, Machine, persistence session, runtime/video adapters and immutable sources; it converts pause-correct host time into one at-most-32768-masterclock slice per host cycle, schedules PPU/S-SMP/enhancement owners from the same guest clock, accepts focused physical port-1 input, publishes native XRGB32 once through triple-buffered shared-raster generations with exact reader leases and bounded copy fallback, routes caller-owned 48-kHz PCM only through App-Audio, supports pause/resume/reset/mute/unmute and unwinds every close/error path in reverse order idempotently. A ReleaseSafe maturity gate proves exact NTSC/PAL machine and streamed-PCM digests across 1-ms, 17-ms and irregular host pacing, 4096/32768-clock partitions, time regression, cold restart, different instance identity and repeated close. The final Lenovo-only commercial-ROM Teilabnahme confirmed start, image, audio, gameplay, every keyboard mapping and window/lifecycle behavior; approximately 5 FPS were explicitly accepted for 0.73.X, while writer-lease, reopen and cold-start observations were discarded rather than reported as PASS. 0.78.6 skips both persistence clocks for non-battery slices while retaining time and backend polls for active saves; the common audio runtime paces silence and keeps streams across transient producer gaps. Historical maturity digests above precede the 0.78.5 source-clock correction; current focused clock/launch checks use 2.048 MHz and the 0.78.6 performance series uses that corrected work. 0.78.13: one normalized borrowed ROM through reset; retained save lease and old guest on preparation failure.
